about:
Lendy Electric Equipment & Supply Corp. has operated from 176 Grand Street in New York City since 1973. The company serves the five boroughs of New York City and ships nationwide, offering local delivery within the metro area. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm distributes electrical, lighting, and hardware supplies, carrying major brands such as GE, Lutron, Eaton-Cutler Hammer, 3M, Benjamin Moore, Klein Tools, Stanley Tools, Juno, Hunter Fans, RAB, Cooper, Lightolier, Satco, Sunlite, Lotus, Topaz, Siemens, NuHeat, and Broan-Nutone. It provides lighting quotes via a dedicated email address and maintains a storefront open six days a week.

Customers include contractors, electricians, and building managers across the New York metropolitan area and beyond, though specific client names are not published. The company’s product range covers wiring devices, lighting fixtures, tools, paint, and ventilation equipment.

Lendy Electric emphasizes long-standing local presence and broad brand availability as its core value proposition, positioning itself as a single source for electrical and lighting needs.
